tasks.label: Run payroll backend
tasks.command: $maven = Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.maven" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin\mvn.cmd' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($maven) { & $maven -f backend\pom.xml spring-boot:run } else { mvn -f backend\pom.xml spring-boot:run }
